note: entity_reference_override adds the field type entity_reference_override ('Entity reference w/custom text'), a subclass of core EntityReferenceItem with extra storage columns override (varchar 4094) + override_format, field settings override_label + override_format, widgets entity_reference_override_autocomplete (default) + entity_reference_override_select, and formatters entity_reference_override_label (default, with override_action in {title,title-append,suffix,class,hide}) + entity_reference_override_entity. It has NO admin UI (configure=null), no permissions, no Drush, no plugin TYPES. Medium cases introspect the LIVE plugin definitions (field-type class + provided formatters), read cheaply via plugin.manager.field.field_type / plugin.manager.field.formatter. Hard cases have the agent write the field-creation / formatter-config CODE into deletable scratch files under web/sites/default/ (entity_reference_override_field.eval.php, entity_reference_override_formatter.eval.php) which verify greps and reset deletes. NOTE: hard cases use scratch-file authoring rather than live field creation on purpose -- on THIS shared site 'canvas' is enabled and reacts to field/display definition changes, so attaching a FieldConfig or saving a view display for this field type is extremely slow / hangs, and a full 'drush cr' fatals in an unrelated canvas/ui_patterns component-manager collision; the scratch-file approach still verifies real filesystem state the agent produced. All facts grounded in src/Plugin/Field/**, entity_reference_override.module and config/schema.

evals.prompt: I want an entity reference field where I can also type a custom per-reference title. Which Drupal field type does entity_reference_override add, and what does it store beyond a normal reference?
evals.expected_output: It adds the field type entity_reference_override ('Entity reference w/custom text'), a subclass of core's entity reference that stores an extra 'override' text value (and override_format) per reference, used to override the referenced entity's title (or class/note/field).

evals.prompt: With the entity_reference_override Label formatter, what are the ways the custom text can be applied to the referenced entity's title? Name the options.
evals.expected_output: The entity_reference_override_label formatter has an override_action setting: title (replace the title), title-append (append to the title), suffix (add a note after the link), class (add a CSS class to the link), or hide.

evals.prompt: Which widgets and formatters does the entity_reference_override module provide for its field type?
evals.expected_output: Widgets: entity_reference_override_autocomplete (default) and entity_reference_override_select. Formatters: entity_reference_override_label (default; Label with override) and entity_reference_override_entity (Rendered entity with override).

evals.prompt: On this running Drupal site, inspect the field-type plugin definitions and tell me the PHP class that implements the entity_reference_override field type, plus its default widget and default formatter.
evals.expected_output: Class Drupal\entity_reference_override\Plugin\Field\FieldType\EntityReferenceOverride; default_widget entity_reference_override_autocomplete; default_formatter entity_reference_override_label. Discoverable with: drush php:eval "var_export(\Drupal::service('plugin.manager.field.field_type')->getDefinition('entity_reference_override'));".

evals.prompt: On this live site, inspect the field-formatter plugin definitions and list the formatters that entity_reference_override provides for its field type.
evals.expected_output: entity_reference_override_label (Label with override) and entity_reference_override_entity (Rendered entity with override). Discoverable with: drush php:eval "\$m=\Drupal::service('plugin.manager.field.formatter'); var_export([(bool)\$m->getDefinition('entity_reference_override_label'),(bool)\$m->getDefinition('entity_reference_override_entity')]);".
